messages:
Ashok: Heads up — found plaintext AWS access key in a partner ingestion log stored in S3. Notified partner already.
SecBot: SecretDetector alert: HIGH risk -> s3://incoming/partner/2026-03-22/log.gz contains pattern AKIA[REDACTED].
Maria: Ugh. Can you paste a redacted sample and the exact time window? Which env (prod/staging)?
Ashok: redacted sample: AKIA****abcd. Found in staging object from 2026-03-22 18:14 UTC. Looks like partner downscope creds used for the lambda.
Liam: @Oncall can you triage rotate + RBAC lockdown? We should treat this as credential exposure until proven otherwise.
Oncall: Ack. I'll coordinate with Platform. Plan: revoke compromised key, issue temp key, push new secret to Vault, then rewrap KMS blobs. Assigning owners here.
Maya: Quick Q: does this Vault instance use AWS KMS CMK or GCP KMS for transit? Rewrap procedure differs.
Ashok: Vault transit backed by AWS KMS CMK in us-west-2 for this cluster.
DevOps: Proposed checklist:
- create rotated partner creds in partner console and validate connectivity
- put new creds in Vault: `vault kv put secret/ingest/partner/partner-123 access_key=AKIA... secret_key=xxxx`
- revoke old key in partner console and mark as leaked
- re-encrypt S3 objects with `aws kms re-encrypt` or via Vault re-wrap if blobs are Vault-wrapped
- tighten ingest IAM policy to reduce blast radius
- snapshot CloudTrail + Vault audit for the timeframe

Ashok: I'm already working with partner to rotate. They issued a new key pair and asked us to update. I'll push to Vault once we confirm key validation.
Liam: I'll run a scoped re-encrypt job for the small object set. Need list of object keys. Ashok, can you run a quick list and drop it here?
Ashok: Ran `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket incoming --prefix partner/2026-03-22/` — ~18 objects. Pushed list and object metadata to the incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-7890
Maya: I'll pull Vault audit log and CloudTrail slice for 2026-03-22 17:00–19:00 UTC and archive it to the ticket. Also enabling additional audit logging for 7 days.
DevOps: RBAC change: will restrict the ingest role to the partner IP CIDR and enforce STS short-lived creds (session duration 15m) for new sessions. We'll canary to staging first and then prod.
Oncall: Timeline: rotate creds and push to Vault by +2h. Rewrap objects and revoke old key by +4h. RBAC rollout to staging +6h, prod after verification.
Maria: Also scan repo history for accidental pastes of that key pattern with `git-secrets` and create a PR to purge any accidental leak.
Ashok: Scanned — nothing in git. Looks isolated to logs.
Liam: Starting re-encrypt job now (canary on 3 objects). Command I'm using:```aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://old.enc --destination-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1111:key/abcd-1234 --output text > new.enc```
Liam: canary succeeded for 3 objects, switching to full set.
Maya: Audit snapshot attached to ticket. Noted a `Vault: kv:get` from service-account `ingest-runner` at 18:13:02 UTC — correlates with the log.
DevOps: Completed RBAC change in staging (restricted CIDR + enforced short sessions). No issues. Preparing prod rollout in 30m.
Oncall: Old compromised key revoked by partner at 19:05 UTC. Vault updated with new key at 19:12 UTC. Re-encrypt finished at 19:35 UTC.
Maria: Nice. Any follow-up items?
Ashok: Follow-ups: 1) run periodic scan for AKIA pattern on S3 lifecycle for 7 days (owner: Ashok), 2) add partner to onboarding checklist to avoid long-lived keys (owner: DevOps), 3) postmortem draft in 48h (owner: Maria).
Oncall: Closing incident thread here, moving artifacts to SEC-7890. :white_check_mark: :lock:
DevOps: Dropping the runbook snippet for future reference: ```# rotate and rewrap quick commands
# 1) revoke key in partner console
# 2) vault kv put secret/ingest/partner/<id> access_key=<new> secret_key=<new>
# 3) aws s3 cp s3://incoming/partner/<obj> ./ && aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://./old --destination-key-id <new-kms>```
SecBot: Incident closed: severity=low-after-mitigation, ticket=SEC-7890, responders=[Ashok,Maria,Liam,DevOps,Oncall], artifacts_attached=true
